title: Hixkaryána language and pronunciation - Omniglot
text: Hixkaryána is a member of the Southern Guiana branch of Cariban languages. It is spoken in Pará and Amazonas states of Brazil on the Nhamundá, Mapuera and Japatú rivers, tributaries of the Amazon. In the year 2000 there were about 600 speakers of Hixkaryána.
